direction: negative raw total local-parameter gradient at exact zero initialization; no normalization, optimizer or optimizer state
guard_reduction: relu after equal-example mean raw Cartesian objective over all 60 examples
independent_copies: fresh local parameter copy from theta0 for every scale; no cumulative displacement
shared_direction_policy: prove initial directions equal for all nine variant/tolerance combinations, then reuse four identical physical points while reporting all 36 combinations
metric_reduction: equal-example mean MSE; RMSE reported both sqrt(mean MSE) and mean per-example RMSE; primary mean-local RMSE follows preparation mean per-example convention
chirality_primary: pooled inversion rate on jointly assessable windows; also report paired common baseline/point assessability and retained-assessability counts
